chat-inbox.persona: Priya Shah (member), Example Corp, dark theme, Face avatars
chat-inbox.capture: Hero, 1440x900. A conversation with Assistant open on the right: Priya's question, a finished reply with its reasoning and two tool steps folded above a Markdown answer with a table. The inbox on the left with a pinned row, one row under Working with its timer, and Inbox rows marked Done and Failed. Also drawn into public/og.png.
chat-inbox.alt: Pi Agent Interface for Priya Shah at Example Corp: the inbox on the left, with a pinned conversation, one under Working with a running timer, and Inbox rows marked Done and Failed; on the right a conversation with Assistant, its reasoning and tool steps folded above an answer with a table.
chat-inbox.caption: Every conversation with every one of your agents, in one inbox that shows what is working, what is done and what failed.

tool-steps.persona: Priya Shah (member), Example Corp, dark theme
tool-steps.capture: 1440x900. A reply whose tool steps are open: a terminal step showing "$ command" and its output, a step with simple inputs as name and value, JSON output indented, the Copy button visible; one step that failed, with an alert icon and the word "failed".
tool-steps.alt: A reply with its tool steps opened: a terminal command shown as "$ command" with its output, a web search with its query, indented JSON output with a Copy button, and one step that failed, marked with an alert icon and the word "failed".
tool-steps.caption: Each tool step shows what it acted on. Opened, it shows the command, the inputs and the output, ready to copy.

inbox-rows.persona: Priya Shah (member), Example Corp, dark theme
inbox-rows.capture: 1440x900, cropped to the sidebar is fine. Inbox rows of three lines (agent, title, time): Working with a timer, Done, Failed and Woke in the corner, a pin on a pinned row, and the hover actions Pin, Snooze and Settle on the row under the pointer.
inbox-rows.alt: The inbox: rows showing the agent, the conversation's title and a compact time, with Working and a timer, Done, Failed and Woke in the corner, a pin on a pinned row, and the hover actions Pin, Snooze and Settle.
inbox-rows.caption: Working, Done and Failed come from the platform's own status, live from its event stream.

inbox-snooze.persona: Priya Shah (member), Example Corp, dark theme
inbox-snooze.capture: 1440x900. A row's Snooze menu open, listing each choice with its wake time and Custom…; the Snoozed, Settled and Archived shelves visible below the inbox.
inbox-snooze.alt: A conversation's Snooze menu, with each choice showing when the conversation will come back, and Custom…; below the inbox, the Snoozed, Settled and Archived shelves.
inbox-snooze.caption: A snooze ends early when the agent finishes or fails. Settled conversations come back when something new happens.

phone-inbox.persona: Priya Shah (member), Example Corp, dark theme
phone-inbox.capture: 390x844 at 2x. The inbox on a phone, with a conversation under Working and the row actions shown (they are always visible on touch screens).
phone-inbox.alt: Pi Agent Interface on a phone: the inbox with a conversation under Working and its row actions shown.
phone-inbox.caption: On touch screens the row actions are always shown.

connect.persona: Priya Shah (member), Example Corp, dark theme. Needs a deployment in Connect mode (PLATFORM_AUTH=connect), captured before she has connected.
connect.capture: 1440x900. The "Connect your agents" screen Priya sees right after signing in: the app's name, the sentence about using her account on the agent platform, the two points (her agents live in her personal workspace with her teams' agents beside them; the app acts only on her agents, as her, and she can disconnect it), the Connect button, and "Signed in as priya.shah@example.com. Sign out" under it.
connect.alt: The Connect your agents screen: Pi Agent Interface asks Priya Shah to connect her own account on the agent platform, says her agents live in her personal workspace with her teams' agents beside them, and that she can disconnect at any time; a Connect button, and below it her email with Sign out.
connect.caption: After signing in, each person connects their own platform account once. Their agents live in their personal workspace, beside their teams' agents.

account-connection.persona: Priya Shah (member), Example Corp, dark theme. Needs a deployment in Connect mode, captured after she has connected.
account-connection.capture: 1440x900. Settings › Account, scrolled to the Agent platform section: Connected account with her platform email, and the Disconnect row with its button. The Profile and Sessions sections may show above and below.
account-connection.alt: Settings › Account, Agent platform: the connected account, Priya Shah's email on the platform, and a Disconnect button with a line saying her agents and conversations stay on the platform.
account-connection.caption: Disconnect any time. Your agents and conversations stay on the platform.

agent-picker.persona: Priya Shah (member), Example Corp, dark theme, Face avatars
agent-picker.capture: 1440x900. The agent picker open on a new conversation: provided agents (Assistant, HR Helper) grouped above Priya's own (Release notes), each with its animated avatar.
agent-picker.alt: The agent picker on a new conversation: the provided agents Assistant and HR Helper, and Priya's own agent Release notes, each with its avatar.
agent-picker.caption: The agents your administrators provide, and the ones you made, in one picker.

my-agents.persona: Priya Shah (member), Example Corp, dark theme
my-agents.capture: 1440x900. Settings › My agents with one agent of her own and the dialog to make another: a name, a template from the allowed ones, and a model.
my-agents.alt: Settings › My agents: Priya's agent Release notes, and the dialog to make another, with a name, a template chosen from the allowed ones and a model.
my-agents.caption: Make agents from the templates your administrators allow, rename them, move them to another model, or delete them.

avatar-styles.persona: Priya Shah (member), Example Corp, dark theme
avatar-styles.capture: 1440x900. Settings › Customization: appearance, accent and the Avatar style choice showing Face, Signal and Pixel.
avatar-styles.alt: Settings › Customization: the appearance and accent, and the avatar styles Face, Signal and Pixel to choose from.
avatar-styles.caption: Avatars show what the agent is doing: thinking, working, waiting, needs you, done, error or asleep.

admin-agents.persona: Alex Morgan (administrator), Example Corp, dark theme
admin-agents.capture: 1440x900. Admin › Agents: Everyone's agents (default model, agents each person may make: 5, People choose the model on, the allowed templates) and Provided agents (Assistant and HR Helper).
admin-agents.alt: Admin › Agents: the default model, five agents each person may make, people choosing the model, the allowed templates, and the provided agents Assistant and HR Helper.
admin-agents.caption: Every person gets a private copy of each provided agent. Models and templates are the ones the platform offers the team.

admin-people.persona: Alex Morgan (administrator), Example Corp, dark theme
admin-people.capture: 1440x900. Admin › People: the Example Corp people with their roles (administrator or member), status (one suspended) and when each was last seen, with the search field.
admin-people.alt: Admin › People: Example Corp's people with their role, administrator or member, their status, one suspended, and when each was last seen.
admin-people.caption: Make people administrators or members, suspend or restore them. A suspension ends their sessions within seconds.

admin-features.persona: Alex Morgan (administrator), Example Corp, dark theme. Needs a deployment in service-account mode (PLATFORM_AUTH=service): with Connect, Usage is locked off.
admin-features.capture: 1440x900. Admin › Features: Usage (on) and Personal usage (off), each with its description.
admin-features.alt: Admin › Features: Usage, turned on, and Personal usage, turned off, each with what it does.
admin-features.caption: Optional features are enforced by the server and hidden in the browser while they are off.

admin-usage.persona: Alex Morgan (administrator), Example Corp, dark theme. Needs a deployment in service-account mode (PLATFORM_AUTH=service): Admin › Usage isn't available with Connect.
admin-usage.capture: 1440x900. Admin › Usage over the last 30 days: requests, tokens and estimated cost per person, and tokens per day.
admin-usage.alt: Admin › Usage for the last 30 days: requests, tokens and an estimated cost for each person, and a chart of tokens per day.
admin-usage.caption: Usage per person, from the platform's usage report, over 7, 30 or 90 days. Needs service-account mode.

admin-audit.persona: Alex Morgan (administrator), Example Corp, dark theme
admin-audit.capture: 1440x900. Admin › Audit log: recent changes such as a role change, a suspension, the agent settings, a provided agent and a feature turned on, each with who and when.
admin-audit.alt: Admin › Audit log: recent changes, among them a role change, a suspension, new agent settings and a feature turned on, each with who made it and when.
admin-audit.caption: Every administrative change is recorded.
